description: Use the Self Assessment helpsheet (HS263) to work out tax credit relief on income that you've paid foreign tax on.

details.body:
If you’ve already paid foreign tax on your income which is also chargeable to UK tax, use this guide to work out how to claim Foreign Tax Credit Relief.

The guide can also help with foreign dividends and reliefs against Capital Gains Tax.

change_history.note: The helpsheet and working sheets for the tax year 2025 to 2026 have been added. The helpsheet and working sheets for the tax year 2021 to 2022 have been removed.
The helpsheet and working sheets for the tax year 2024 to 2025 have been added. The helpsheet and working sheets for the tax year 2020 to 2021 have been removed.
The helpsheet and working sheets for the tax year 2023 to 2024 have been added. The helpsheet and working sheets for the tax year 2019 to 2020 have been removed.
The helpsheet and working sheets for the tax year 2022 to 2023 have been added. The helpsheet and working sheets for the tax year 2018 to 2019 have been removed.
Helpsheet and working sheets for the tax year 2021 to 2022 have been added. Helpsheet and working sheets for 2018 have been removed.
Helpsheet and working sheets for the tax year 2020 to 2021 have been added.
The working sheet 1 for income 2020 has been replaced with an updated version.
Helpsheet and working sheets have been added for the tax year 2019 to 2020.
The working sheet for Foreign Tax Credit Relief 2018 has been updated.
The renamed 2018 to 2019 helpsheet and working sheets have been added to this page.
The 2017 to 2018 helpsheet and working sheet have been added to this page.
The 2016 to 2017 helpsheet and working sheet have been added to this page.
The HS263 Self Assessment helpsheet 2016 version has been amended to clarify the foreign tax credit relief on income applies 5 April 2016.
Rates, allowances and duties have been updated for the tax year 2016 to 2017.
Rates, allowances and duties have been updated for the tax year 2015 to 2016.
